arguments.message: Hi! To see if you’ve been added to the SSO sync, go to Settings → People in your workspace. If your account is listed there and is marked with the identity provider it came from, the sync has created it. If you don’t see your account, the sync hasn’t added it yet – you’ll need to wait for the next sync cycle or ask your admin to check the sync status.
